descriptor: Online design courses taught by working designers

voice.summary: Sounds like a warm, expert teacher who wants you to finish the lesson: encouraging, concrete and a touch playful about colour. It promises skills you can use on Monday, not vague transformation.
dos: Name the exact skill, such as testing a palette against contrast rules
Include lesson counts and minutes so the effort is clear
Speak to the learner as you, with a kind tone
donts: Do not use fake countdown pressure
Do not talk down to beginners

taglines: Learn colour. Then use it well.
Palettes that look good and pass checks
See colour the way designers do
boilerplate: Studio School runs short online courses for designers, taught by working practitioners such as Priya Nair-Walsh, with clear lessons, practical exercises and a money-back guarantee.

microcopy.success: You are in. Lesson one is ready.
microcopy.error: Payment did not go through. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No lessons here yet. Expand a module to begin.

logo.note: An open book is a simple, friendly sign for a school and its step-by-step lessons.
